name: Evolve
summary: AI-native training and enablement platform for enterprises: an LMS with branded academies, an AI course generator, job-skill simulations with AI counterparts, an assessment center and performance analytics — used by 100+ deployed enterprises.
best_for: enterprises and scale-ups that need structured, measurable training rolled out across hundreds of employees — branded academies, AI-generated courses, job-skill simulations and assessment in one platform
skip_if: you're a small team that just needs a course builder or a lightweight LMS — the enterprise machinery and the procurement process are more than the job requires
honest_knock: It's built for large organizations — the site claims 100+ enterprises deployed globally and 2.9M+ learners trained, with Danone among the named references — and the sales-led, quote-only motion reflects that: there is no self-serve tier to trial quietly, so smaller teams can't just kick the tires before procurement gets involved.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on evolveplatform.ai) No public price list -- there is no /pricing page and the call to action across the site is 'Book an intro'. The platform is modular by design and the quote is built from which modules you contract and how many seats: Evolve Learning, Course Generate, Evolve Studio course builder, Assessment Center, Knowledge base and Simulations -- six independent but connected products, not four. Budget for an enterprise-tier commitment.

cost_traps.label: Quote-only pricing
cost_traps.evidence: No public price list; modular platform quoted per module and seat count via 'Book an intro' (re-verified 22 Sep 2026)

compare_with.name: Docebo or 360Learning
compare_with.why: the established enterprise-LMS names win on integration marketplaces and long track records; Evolve wins on AI-native course generation and built-in job simulations with AI counterparts
